en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a Central European spa or resort town nestled in a forested valley. In the foreground are sloped roofs of 19th‑century houses and a building with a large circular window. Beyond lies a landscaped park with winding paths, lawns and mature trees. At the heart of the scene stand several ornate Neo‑Renaissance and Neo‑Baroque buildings with domes and towers, one with a tall chimney, resembling grand spa pavilions or sanatorium complexes. Dense coniferous forested hills form the backdrop, enclosing the town.
